items.text: For SNF, Rams WR Puka Nacua and Broncos WR Marvin Mims are both inactive. Schefter earlier: Nacua doubtful (groin impacting explosiveness), short-term, possible next week.
items.implication: Zero week; Adams and LAR WRs elevated. Monitor return next week.
items.opportunity: Full target/route share boost to Davante Adams and remaining Rams receivers.

items.text: Vikings now have ruled out WR Justin Jefferson due to an ankle injury.
items.why: Ruled out after ankle injury during game.
items.implication: Zero rest of game/week; check severity. Boost to other MIN pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Addison and remaining WRs/TEs.

items.text: 49ers now have ruled out WR Mike Evans due to a rib injury after being carted off. Rapoport: rib strain, full eval tomorrow, can be painful.
items.why: Carted off, ruled out mid-game with ribs.
items.implication: Zero rest of game; painful injury may linger. SF WR depth elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining SF WRs (e.g. Deebo if applicable).

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall has been ruled out with a thigh injury.
items.why: Ruled out after in-game thigh injury; ETR watching as quad.
items.implication: Zero rest of game; severity TBD for ROS. Backup RB opportunity.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps/targets for Braelon Allen and Jets RB depth.

items.text: TE Brock Bowers is active and will make his 2026 season debut today (vs NO). Rapoport confirms active.
items.why: Officially active per team/Schefter/Rapoport; ETR expected.
items.implication: Immediate TE1 upside but possible snap limit on return. Start if rostered.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets expected; reverse any Mayer stash if full go.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane has been ruled out vs. the Chiefs due to a knee injury. Rapoport: coach Jeff Hafley 'does not sound optimistic' on major concern.
items.why: Ruled out mid/late game; coach major concern per Rapoport.
items.implication: Zero week; monitor severity for ROS. Handcuff/backup RBs elevated.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity to remaining MIA RBs (snaps/carries/targets).

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active today vs. the Cowboys after pregame workout testing hamstring; looked good. Rapoport notes likely limited usage.
items.implication: Startable but capped snaps/routes; monitor volume vs Bateman/Andrews.
items.opportunity: If limited, boost to Bateman/Andrews targets/red-zone.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Achane (knee), Jefferson (ankle), Hall (quad), Etienne (hamstring), Evans (rib), Mayfield (thumb)/McMillan (knee), Coker (quad), Andrews (hand), Spears (ankle), Bech (broken forearm).
items.implication: ROS monitoring for these; waivers/handcuffs for prolonged outs.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries already noted in individual OUTs; Etienne/Andrews/Spears status TBD.

items.text: Todd Bowles said Bucs QB Baker Mayfield dislocated his right thumb and will undergo an MRI. Rapoport: likely to miss time.
items.why: Post-game coach confirmation after in-game injury on INT.
items.implication: Backup QB next week+; TB pass-catchers (Evans already out, Godwin, McMillan) impacted.
items.opportunity: Potential QB change affects all TB skill players' ceilings.

items.text: Raiders promising young WR Jack Bech, ruled out, suffered broken forearm; headed for IR but should return later this season. ETR watching.
items.why: Sources confirm break and IR path.
items.implication: Longer absence; LV WR depth thinned (Bowers active helps TE).
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for remaining Raiders WRs.

items.text: Risky but if Flowers is active for Baltimore he's active for me. I would start him over Bateman.
items.why: Active status overrides prior uncertainty; prefer over Bateman.
items.implication: Start Flowers in fantasy if rostered; fade pure Bateman pivots.
items.conflict: ETR/Levitan initially projected out with late-swap Bateman/Andrews plans.

items.text: Actives include Steelers RB Jaylen Warren and (earlier) WR Michael Pittman expected/active (foot). ETR listed both expected to play.
items.why: Official actives/expected reports from Schefter; ETR summary.
items.implication: Full go for both; Warren strong opportunity with Dowdle out context.
items.opportunity: Warren elevated RB role/snaps; Pittman normal WR targets.

items.text: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell (Q finger) expected inactive vs Lions (confirmed). Jets WRs today: 1. Garrett Wilson 2. Isaiah Williams 3. Jamaal Pritchett 4. Sterling Shepard 5. Malik McLain. Also expecting TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide decent amount. ETR/Levitan had Mitchell out in projs.
items.why: Fowler source + Schefter/Rapoport actives list; Levitan depth chart.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1 with massive target upside; Sadiq hybrid role.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target share for Wilson; secondary WRs and Sadiq elevated.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore (shoulder Q) expected to play vs Chargers and is active (with Keon Coleman). Levitan/ETR assumed in but limited.
items.why: Schefter expected + official actives with Coleman.
items.implication: Startable but monitor snaps; Bills WR corps healthier.
items.opportunity: Maintains target competition; limited would boost Coleman/Shakir.

items.text: We have Zay Flowers (hamstring) out in projections right now. Still possible he plays, will keep late swap in mind for Bateman/Andrews DFS. Moore in (limited), Mitchell out. Updated assumptions pending.
items.why: No final info early; conservative out with DFS flexibility.
items.implication: Initial fade Flowers / pivot Bateman-Andrews; late ACTIVE changed calculus.
items.conflict: Later ACTIVE + Berry start-over-Bateman; Schefter/Rap ACTIVE limited.

items.text: Sunday AM summary: GTD Flowers (not counting on), Spears hopeful. Expected: Warren/Pittman, Barkley/Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman. Q: Parkinson trending right, Bagent. Later injury watch: Achane/Jefferson/Hall/Evans/Mayfield/etc.
items.why: Comprehensive pregame report aligning Schefter beat notes.
items.implication: Clear start signals for expected group pre-confirmation; Flowers was the main swing.

items.text: Panthers WR Xavier Legette out, but Jalen Coker is up/active. Schefter confirms Coker active.
items.implication: Coker elevated WR role in CAR.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for Coker with Legette out.

items.text: 10 Facts: After Stevenson fumble, Henderson 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game (still ranks Stevenson ahead). With Collins out, Schultz 28% target share / 30% routes; good vs Colts TE D. London strong with Penix (20+ PPR, 35% share career).
items.why: Post-fumble usage spike for Henderson; Schultz volume spike w/ Collins out; London-Penix history.
items.implication: Henderson rising but not full takeover; Schultz TE streamer; London smash vs matchup.
items.opportunity: Henderson snap/carry share expansion; Schultz routes/targets; London high target share.
